name: Higashiura (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Higashiura town emblem in black: a stylised house-like shape with a pointed top enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Higashiura, a town in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 September 1958.

features.role: Higashiura town emblem — a stylised house-like shape with a pointed top enclosing a ring
